distance: minimum Euclidean distance between future12-point polyline and existing current graph lane segment; segment endpoints preserved
nearest_ties: GT distance exact ties choose smallest local lane index; attention rank uses average ties over all graph lanes with zero weight assigned to missing edges. Report tied-nearest count and best-ranked co-nearest sensitivity at distance tolerance1e-8m. TopK mean-alpha ties sorted local lane index.
nearest_scope: PRIMARY: all existing current-graph lane segments, including those outside unchanged incoming50m edge mask. Their attention weight is zero. Auxiliary metrics condition on incoming edges to distinguish route coverage from attention selection.
attention_denominator: mean across actors having at least one retained edge; zero-edge actors separately counted and excluded from rank/entropy; no fabricated ranks
turn_options: unique left/straight/right turn types from distinct connector tokens with full centerline distance<20m, all regional map tokens
turn_match: highest mean-alpha connector; tie by lane index; NO_CONNECTOR included as nonmatch in primary turning-group rate; conditional connector-present rate secondary
SHUFFLE: independent within-graph permutation using SeedSequence([2022, first32bits of SHA256(scene_token+sample_token)]); independent of batching/access order; exact geometry/actor fields preserved
CENTERED: evaluation-only semantic_mlp output hook subtracts frozen r(0); no checkpoint/state changes

bootstrap.pooling: paired actor sums/counts, metric-specific finite mask

decisions: Use user A/B/C/D evidence rules; require consistent group bootstrap direction plus attention-error association for A; improved/stable relevance with material K/V residual and OOD changes for B; large constant alone insufficient for C unless specific component limited and ON≈SHUFFLE. Conflicting or weak signals yield D. Associations and OOD perturbations cannot establish mechanism causality. No thresholds selected from results.
primary_attention_population: Overall Vehicle full-horizon targets; also report Overall54990, moving, >5m, TurningVehicle_GT and Pedestrian secondary
